about: Written for this test: a recipe-card style chili (how-to words after names with no comma, 'about' asides, cans, a toppings list at the end).
name: Weeknight Bean Chili
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes peeled and ½-inch diced (about 1 pound)
1 teaspoon kosher salt plus more to taste
1 (28-ounce) can diced tomatoes in their juices
2 (15-ounce) cans black beans, rinsed and drained
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium. Add the onion, bell peppers, and sweet potatoes and cook, stirring now and then, until the onions turn translucent, about 10 minutes.
Reduce the heat to medium low. Add the garlic, tomato paste, chili powder, cumin, cocoa powder, salt, and cayenne. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, beans, and broth. Bring to a boil. Partly cover the pot and reduce the heat to a simmer. Keep cooking for 30 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning, adding more salt or cayenne if you like.
Serve with the toppings: avocado, cilantro and lime wedges.
